provenance: Synthetic development scenarios, including paraphrases of user-reported GGUF failures. No captured conversations or held-out benchmark examples.

scenario.documentPrefix: i'm using gguf models and the predictions are not correct.
scenario.screenText: A comparison of local autocomplete tools. One option uses Apple on-device models; the other loads local weights.

phrases.text: They need gguf to run locally.

scenario.documentPrefix: We are discussing portable model files.
scenario.screenText: File formats: GGUF stores model weights for llama.cpp. MLX uses a different runtime. No internet connection is needed.
MLX targets Apple silicon. The other participant is asking about an older Intel laptop.

scenario.screenText: A writer is reporting poor suggestions from locally loaded models and comparing another backend.

phrases.text: Can you send me the address?

scenario.screenText: A friend has invited us to dinner but has not provided the street or building number.

phrases.text: Thanks for getting back to me.

scenario.screenText: A colleague just replied to a question sent yesterday. There is no urgent follow-up.

phrases.text: Please send the report by Friday.

scenario.screenText: The manager needs the weekly report before the end of the week. The agreed deadline is Friday.

phrases.text: The meeting has been moved to Tuesday.

scenario.screenText: Calendar update: the Monday review is cancelled. A replacement appointment is booked for Tuesday.

phrases.text: We need to buy milk and bread.

scenario.screenText: Kitchen inventory: milk is empty and the last loaf of bread was used at breakfast. Eggs are still stocked.

phrases.text: It looks like it is going to rain.

scenario.screenText: Dark clouds are gathering and the forecast shows showers this afternoon. Take an umbrella.

phrases.text: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.

scenario.screenText: Lab observation: ice first appeared when the thermometer read 0 C at standard atmospheric pressure.

phrases.text: I really enjoyed watching that movie.

scenario.screenText: We watched a film last night and talked about the performances afterward. The response was positive.

phrases.text: I would like to book a room.

scenario.screenText: A hotel has rooms available for two adults next weekend. The guest is writing to make a reservation.
The itinerary shows departure at 09:00 on the following day. The airport recommends arriving two hours early.
